integration_removed.description:
The Plum Lightpad integration has been removed from Universal Universal Home Assistant.

The required cloud services are no longer available since the Plum servers have been shut down. To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your Universal Universal Home Assistant setup. [View your existing Plum Lightpad integration entries]({entries}).
integration_removed.title: The Plum Lightpad integration has been removed
